title: Vegan Trader Joe’s Highlights and a 24-Hour Budget Cook‑Along (Goodful)
summary: This Goodful video surveys Trader Joe’s vegan-friendly offerings, first spotlighting five items touted as accidentally vegan, then presenting a broader roundup of new vegan-capable products and a practical demonstration: a quick vegan dinner using Impossible Meat, followed by a 24‑hour, budget-conscious meal plan built from Trader Joe’s ingredients. The host previews specific products by name, shares brief tasting notes, and then walks through simple cooking and meal-prep steps (including a quick pickle, open-face grilled cheese Caprese, and avocado toast) aimed at showing how to assemble meals around accessible vegan options.
topics: ube mochi pancake and waffle mix (vegan)
crunchy jalapeño lime and onion chips (vegan)
non-dairy vanilla bean oat frozen dessert
salted caramel dairy cones (vegan status noted in segment)
Bomba peanut snacks (hazelnut vegan; chocolate flavor non-vegan)
apple cider vinegar and white vinegar pickle method

sections.title: Intro: five accidentally vegan Trader Joe’s items
sections.description: Host introduces the video’s theme: five Trader Joe’s items that are accidentally vegan, with quick commentary on why aioli and similar sauces can surprise shoppers.

sections.title: Group 2 highlights: five-plus new vegan items from Trader Joe’s
concepts: salted caramel dairy cones (vegan status noted)
sections.description: Overview of the second wave of new vegan-friendly items. Highlights include non-dairy vanilla bean oat frozen dessert, vegan Bolognese ravioli, Tiny Fruity Cuties cereal, salted caramel cones, Carolina Gold BBQ chips, Arabiata pasta, Bomba snacks (hazelnut flavor noted vegan; chocolate flavor not vegan), Topoki, veggie pai, and a note on vodka’s vegan status.

sections.title: Vegan dinner demonstration: $20 Trader Joe’s dinner challenge
sections.description: A practical vegan dinner demo using Impossible Meat, vegetables, tomato paste, wine reduction, bay leaves, veggie broth, and almond milk. Steps include browning meat, cooking veggies, simmering with liquids, and pasta, finishing with plating and tasting notes.

sections.title: 24 hours of Trader Joe’s food in 24 hours, Part 2 (breakfast to dinner prep)
concepts: tomato, olive oil, salt and pepper for toast
sections.description: Narrative of a 24-hour budget-leaning food plan built from Trader Joe’s. Highlights include sourdough toast for breakfast with avocado toast toppings and balsamic glaze, saving half of avocados, quick cucumber pickling with apple cider and white vinegar, a lunch open-face grilled cheese Caprese with shredded almond cheese and tomato, and a simple toast-based dinner setup.
